name: B1 — Android-ELF vs host-glibc dlopen collision (libGDX game family blocker)

live_evidence.emmanuelttt_stderr: run_s182_minimal2/emmanuelttt.err:95 [S2-NATIVE] load gdx (.../lib/x86_64/libgdx.so): dlopen failed: /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libm.so: invalid ELF header
live_evidence.cause: bionic DT_NEEDED names collide with host glibc GNU ld scripts: /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libm.so is a 140-byte TEXT script (invalid ELF); the real ELF is libm.so.6. A real Android device never hits this (bionic libm.so is an ELF there).

host_mapping_verified.liblog.so -> SHIM REQUIRED: Android logging surface; small compile-time shim (empty __android_log_print family)
host_mapping_verified.libEGL.so / libGLESv2.so / libandroid.so: no host equivalent — these are exactly why TG's dlopen fails and why TG needs the native bridge; bridge/shim law required per surface

law_design (queued): shim-symlink staging dir: extraction law plants <nativeLibraryDir>/shims/{libm.so,libc.so,libdl.so,libstdc++.so,libz.so} -> host SONAME equivalents + compiled liblog.so shim; the RUNTIME SPAWN law exports LD_LIBRARY_PATH=<nativeLibraryDir>/shims:<nativeLibraryDir> when launching the engine process (dlopen DT_NEEDED search honors it — glibc caches it at process start, so it MUST be set at spawn, not setenv). Dedupe safety: ld.so dedupes by (dev,ino), so shim→libc.so.6 cannot double-load libc. Scope: unblocks the whole libGDX natives family (emmanuelttt #11, stacktower3d, bouncy box2d physics); rendering then needs B2 (GL/EGL surface law).
